QuestInfo.name: Le Tierre's Test
QuestInfo.0: You're going to have to build up your reputation with #b#p2154002##k before you get any further with her.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154002# wants you to prove your loyalty to the Black Wings. Eliminate #r#o3150000##k machines, and she will give you a recommendation. It seems a bit too easy, but there's no turning back now!\n\n#o3150000##r #a254151##k
QuestInfo.2: #p2154002# is acting very satisfied at the outcome... why is that?

0.0: You're here because you want to be a more meaningful member of our organization, aren't you? I can tell.
0.1: Don't look so surprised. The Black Wings are always scouting new talent, IF they can prove themselves ready. Show me that you can make the cut by eliminating #r10 #o3150000##k machines, and I'll tell the higher-ups to promote you.

yes.0: I'm offering you the world for a measly 10 #o3150000# machines. I don't offer this to everyone, you know?

no.0: No? I was sure you had some ambition.

1.0: I was glad to witness your abilities with my own eyes. Good to have you aboard.

mob.0: I was hoping you would try a little harder.
